action: Owner buys/controls the domain and sets DNS at the registrar.
validation: External DNS lookup resolves the domain to the host; HTTPS cert valid. Code cannot prove this.

action: Owner creates the hosting project, configures env, connects the repo/domain.
validation: A real deployment exists and the health/readiness endpoint responds. Code cannot prove a deploy occurred.

action: Owner sets each production secret in the host secret manager (never committed).
validation: Presence/shape check in the host env (never the value). Missing prod secret fails closed.

action: Owner creates the production Supabase project and supplies URL + keys.
validation: Connect to the production URL and run the RLS runtime verification script with two test users.

action: Owner explicitly authorizes and runs migrations against the production project.
validation: Migration replay succeeds on the production project + schema matches. Code cannot run live migrations.

action: Run the RLS runtime verification against the production project with two real test accounts.
validation: scripts/rls-runtime-verify.mjs: cross-user isolation blocked on the production DB.

action: Owner enables PITR/backups on the production project and rehearses a restore.
validation: A restore test succeeds on the production project. Code cannot prove backups run.

action: Owner (or authorized company rep) creates the Stripe account, verifies identity + bank.
validation: Owner-gated read-only dry run (scripts/p15-verify-stripe-live-readonly.mjs) + attestation. No live payment.

action: Owner creates the live EUR + CHF recurring prices (active, distinct) in the Stripe dashboard.
validation: Read-only prices.retrieve confirms amount/currency/interval/active. Code cannot create live prices.

action: Owner registers the live webhook endpoint URL in Stripe and copies the whsec_ secret to env.
validation: Stripe dashboard shows the endpoint; a signed test event is accepted. Code cannot prove external registration.

action: Owner adds DNS records at the registrar and verifies the domain in Resend.
validation: Resend dashboard shows domain verified; external DNS lookup shows the records. Code cannot verify DNS.

action: Owner picks/configures a monitoring vendor + alert channels and rehearses rollback.
validation: Alerts fire in the vendor; owner attests CLONESTORE_MONITORING_ROLLBACK_VERIFIED. Code cannot prove vendor config.

action: Operator runs smoke checks against the deployed environment.
validation: Health endpoint 200 + smoke checklist pass on the deployed URL. Code cannot prove a deploy.

action: Owner completes the go-live approval packet AND makes a deliberate code change to lift PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED.
validation: canAuthorizeProduction()=true requires all gates + owner sign-off + a code change. Never from env.
